testCase.name: [本地] S21 axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S21 「Medications 面板和 Medication Tracker 上的 axe、手机宽度和 WebKit，每种状态，两种模式」 axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on …（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 What；TFA-92597 AC 3）
  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56).（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 AC 3）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture with rows in every status (active, held, changed, discontinued, single dose, one row last mentioned 20 h ago for the label), including long names, tags and reasons; profiles desktop, pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Run axe and the layout checks on Hospital Pre-Round (panel read-only and editor open), Hospital Post-Round → meds, and Nursing Home Pre-Round (panel read-only and editor open)

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; every status has a text badge, not colour alone; 'Remove <drug>' buttons, the status select and the change-note input have accessible names. On phone width and WebKit: drug name, change tag and reason wrap without truncation or sideways scroll; status badge readable; Edit, Remove and Save Medications tappable (≥ 24 px)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core: zero serious or critical violations (visual-checks.ts); visual-lane checks covered / overflow / truncated / tap on the same elements on the phone profiles (merged from the former S22; S23 is the device scenario on real phones)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92597 ready for qa

读屏用户编辑用药时只听到「popup button, held」，听不出是哪种药，因为每行的状态下拉框没有可访问名称。

A screen-reader user editing medications hears 'popup button, held' with no drug name, because each row's status dropdown has no accessible name.

依据：Allure b6579774, visual lane: 62 checks passed, 21 failed. axe select-name (critical) on every status select. The change-note inputs are named only by their placeholder (recorded). The phone layout and tap sizes pass. Not in the dev report or ledger.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S21

axe, phone width and WebKit on the Medications panel and the Medication Tracker, every status, both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：preround.spec.ts: six seeded medications (active, held, changed, discontinued, single-dose, one 20 h old) in both contexts: panel read-only and editor open, plus Hospital Post-Round → meds; axe, text badge per status, Remove/status select/change-note names, phone layout and sizes. [2026-10-14 review] 'covered' added to the phone layout checks (the oracle names covered / overflow / truncated / tap).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 62 judged check(s) passed, 21 failed. Every status has a text badge; Remove <drug> buttons are named; change-note inputs are named only by placeholder (recorded); phone layout and sizes pass.

产品问题：In the Medications editor every row's status dropdown (active / held / changed / discontinued / single-dose) has no accessible name (axe select-name, critical): VoiceOver reads 'popup button, held' with no drug — a physician using a screen reader cannot tell which drug's status they are changing (oracle: the status select has an accessible name).

只记录的格子（recorded）：vision-review (for a person): one row says 'discontinued' in its badge and 'Stopped · Oct 13' in its change chip; Pre-Round panel and Post-Round tracker style the same statuses differently.

证据：附了 8 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-19_S21 — 目录（33 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
